Name: magnolia tx
Description: Magnolia, Texas. Real streets and addresses from OpenStreetMap and public records. A 3 km square of the woods and subdivisions south of the town, round Bobcat Lane, Nichols Sawmill Road and Butera Road. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); buildings from Overture Maps (Microsoft ML Buildings, OpenStreetMap, USGS lidar); addresses from the US National Address Database and Census TIGER/Line; tree cover from ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0). Lot lines, rooms and the individual trees are generated. Made by tools/gen_osm.py.
